question: In which of the following years was the Planning Commission set up with the Prime Minister as its Chairperson, and hence began the era of five-year plans.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1950.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Planning Commission:**

 
 
• It was set up in **1950 **with the **Prime Minister** as its **Chairperson**, marking the beginning of the era of five-year plans in India.
 
• The **first five-year plan** was launched in **1951** with the objective of achieving** rapid industrialization** and **economic growth.**
 
• The Planning Commission was responsible for formulating and implementing the five-year plans, which were aimed at achieving specific targets for various sectors such as** agriculture, industry, and infrastructure.**
 
• The five-year plans continued until **2014**, when they were replaced by the **NITI Aayog, **a policy think tank that serves as the government's premier policy-making body.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• NITI Aayog:

 
 
• The G**overnment of India's premier think tank on public policy,** NITI Aayog is the **nodal agency responsible for promoting cooperative federalism, encouraging economic development, and eschewing bargaining federalism** by involving State Governments of India in the formulation of economic policies.
 
• It emphasis on a **bottom-up methodology. **
 
• It took over the role of the Planning Commission when it was founded in 2015.
 
• Chairperson: Narendra Modi, The Prime Minister (ex-officio)
 
• Vice Chairperson: Suman Bery
 
• CEO: B. V. R. Subrahmanyam
 
• HQ: New Delhi, India
